children.name: Kellicottia bostoniensis
children.description: Kellicottia bostoniensis is a type of freshwater, planktonic rotifer. bostoniensis belongs to the family Brachionidae. bostoniensis is originally from North America, but invasive populations can now be found in Europe, Asia and South America as well.

children.name: Keratella cochlearis
children.description: Keratella cochlearis is a rotifer. The planktonic animal occurs worldwide in freshwater and marine habitats.
